_note: Tuning knobs for kgb/map. Every value is optional and type-checked — missing or invalid entries fall back to built-in defaults, so this file can never break the map. Coordinates are [lng, lat].

mask._note: Focus the map on campus. dimOutside fades the outside world 0-1 (0 = off) using dimColor; boundaryFill tints the campus interior (0 = off); restrictPanning keeps the camera near campus (panBuffer in degrees). NOTE: hiding outside 3D buildings via a within-filter is NOT possible — MapLibre within() only evaluates Point/LineString features, building polygons always return false.

detail._note: High-contrast overlays on the bright base (paths are faint #cba there, pitches/parking unstyled). All read from the same openmaptiles planet source.

route._note: maxInAppM: endpoints further than this from the campus boundary skip in-app routing — external providers take over.

faculty._note: Short code (Sheet `fakulti`) to full name. Sheet stores codes only; map shows code by default with full name alongside. Add/remove entries here when faculties change — no code edit needed.

names.FUPL: Fakulti Pengajian Umum dan Pengajian Lanjutan

tint._note: solo: place names (exact match on Sheet `place`) that tint ONLY the footprint containing the pin. soloPrefix: same by name prefix (covers the whole Asrama Blok A–Q family, present and future). For OSM neighbours the tiles fuse into one feature (DABS + Perdana, hostel clusters) — no geometric rule can split those, so list them here. Everything else keeps the same-feature flood.
